g.text: What was matched — and what was different

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #627786

g.text: Equal training data and near-equal total parameters do not imply equal allocation or compute.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #627786

g.text: All runs: 20,000 updates × 8 windows × 128 targets = 20.48 million training-byte exposures. CPU float32, two threads.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #627786

g.text: The GRU uses gates and a different state width. Independent memory is an ablation with fewer parameters; it is not parameter matched.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1e3443
